job.title: Legal Secretary - Multiple Practice Groups!
job.description:
Your next move could be better than you think.

We are currently recruiting for a range of Legal Secretary and Legal Assistant opportunities across Sydney’s leading law firms, and there are some seriously good roles on the table.

Think senior Partner support, interesting legal work, great teams, career progression and competitive salaries - not just another job managing a diary.

  • Roles across Disputes, Litigation, Corporate, Competition, Employment, Finance, Projects, Restructuring & Insolvency, Environment and more
  • Opportunities with top-tier, international and highly regarded Australian firms

Not every great role gets advertised for long, so if you're thinking about making a move, now is a good time to talk.

job.title: Legal Secretary - Employment - International Firm
job.description:
The Opportunity:
Join an internationally renowned law firm and work alongside a high-performing team of employment lawyers. You’ll collaborate with another legal secretary to support the team. The firm has a great down-to-earth culture, dress for your day policy and is friendly and welcoming. This role offers 1 day of work from home.

The Role:
Working in a team of 2, you will support 1 partner directly and a team of 5 lawyers; the other secretary will support the rest of the team. This is a traditional legal secretary role, and you will be assisting with:
  • Diary & email management
  • Billing
  • Assist with events and other BD activities
  • Prepare correspondence and documents
About You:
You have prior law firm experience, and we welcome applications from both intermediate-level and more senior candidates. Experience in a litigated or advisory practice area is essential, given the nature of the work. Beyond that, we are looking for a can-do attitude and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.

What You Will Get:
A salary package of up to $105k, a central CBD office close to transport links, WFH flex and a supportive team that genuinely works as one. You’ll also enjoy all the usual big law firm perks and benefits, plus the opportunity to add an impressive name to your CV to help grow your career.

job.title: Legal Secretary - Top Tier Firm - Litigation
job.description:
The Opportunity:
Join a nationally recognised full-service law firm in their commercial litigation practice. You will support 1 Partner, who is approachable and highly tech-savvy—along with a small team of lawyers. The firm is known for its stability, with an exceptionally low staff turnover. This role also offers an excellent work-life balance, including one day of work-from-home per week and minimal to no overtime. 
  
The Role:
You will provide support to commerical litigation Partner and a small legal team handling matters for their various clients. The Partner is down-to-earth and friendly, and the firm fosters a genuinely welcoming and collegial environment. Your responsibilities will focus on typical Legal Secretary tasks with very few personal assistant duties. These include:
  • Monthly billing
  • Diary and email management
  • Court filing
  • Liaising with clients
  • Expense management
  
About You:
As this role sits within a top-tier law firm, you will need experience at a reputable law firm, and you will have supported up to the Partner level. The ability to work as a team and on your own when needed.
  
What You Will Get:
A salary package of up to $115K, annual salary reviews, one day of remote work per week, a wellbeing program, a subsidised gym membership, five-star end-of-trip facilities, and the opportunity to join a stable, down-to-earth team with a positive and genuine culture.
